reason: The hypothesis relies on FSP and heat treatment creating a graded interface to improve thermal conductivity. Evidence E2 and E3 show this mechanism in an AlCoCrFeNi/Al composite, but none of the cited evidence demonstrates this effect in a W–Cu system or links it to thermal conductivity improvement. The key premises about W–Cu interfacial behavior and thermal transport are unsupported by the provided passages.
